card.name: Company name before Inc. comma
card.fires_on: The last word of a drug company name just before a comma, such as Co in Merck & Co. or Pharmaceutical in Collegium Pharmaceutical, in the pediatric exclusivity statement. It also fires on a digit before a comma inside numbers like 50,000.
